pos: Vehicles parked on lawns, yards, or other non-paved surfaces, including repeated or habitual parking in these areas.
neg: Cars parked on lawns when the main issue is overgrown grass (see Excessive Growth).

pos: Comments or complaints specifically about parks, playgrounds, or recreational events.
neg: Trash or maintenance issues in parks (see Trash or Yard Waste).

neg: Storm drain or street flooding issues (see Sidewalk Snow Removal).

neg: Storm drain or flooding issues (see Sidewalk Snow Removal).

Street light outages, motorists running red lights, or line of sight problems due to bushes when the focus is on traffic safety.
